meta.description: Simulation study for 'The Dark Figure' (synthetic data only; no real incidents).
meta.note: Rerun after SIM-EST's fix of the LCMCR alpha update (lcmcr.py, 2026-11-03 ~20:18 UTC); an earlier run that imported the pre-fix lcmcr.py was aborted and discarded.
meta.seed_scheme: world seed = SeedSequence([base_seed, scenario_index, level_index+1, rep]); pipeline seed = SeedSequence([..., rep, 7]); level_index = -1 for single-level scenarios

estimators.lcmcr: lcmcr(table, **lcmcr_kw) with lcmcr_kw = {"J": 10, "n_iter": 6000, "burn": 2000, "thin": 4}; retained draws per run = (n_iter - burn) / thin = 1000

pipelines.naive: single best linkage (3-class FS EM, greedy constrained, threshold 0.5)
pipelines.corrected_tv: corrected + review uncertainty: 20 draws of (delta, eps) ~ N(hat, se^2), Rubin's rules on log N
pipelines.corrected_lefit: diagnostic: best-fit scalar LE (delta*, eps*) using the oracle table (infeasible)
pipelines.mi: 20 Bernoulli(pi) linkage draws; Rubin's rules on log N (lp, cf, bma, chao); LCMCR: posterior draws pooled over the first 4 imputations
pipelines.oracle_dropref: oracle linkage after dropping referral-only NGO records (provenance flag)

metrics.coverage: P(lo <= N <= hi) for the nominal 95% interval

S3.label: referral dependence q = 0.5 (independent capture), clean records

S7.label: referral sweep with provenance correction (oracle linkage)
